reviews.review:
This is my first game I reviewed on steam, It disserves to be my first , because how good it is.
I love this game the team behind it put a lot of work and time into this game. I have never seen such a good apocalypse game when I bought it, and even still today it holds up, as in my opinion the best survival/mostly apocalypse game ever made.

The enemy design is soo cool, the fear it gives you when you play solo and with friends, the world design is amazing I will always wonder off to explore, you can just find a random places that you look over on the map and it will have good detail. The music is amazing the sound affects too, just go up to a tank as it falls the sound 10/10

This game has bugs and only a few annoying ones that you don't come across to much. but all the other bugs are just funny, it is funny to have a dead tick go Mach 10 or to have a tank you kill come back from the dead for a few seconds and just fall over again dead. and all the DLC's are good and fun. 

One of my favorite things are the experimental weapons, they are so unique (experimental Kvm 59 my beloved)
and the skill tree. You can choose between 4 different skill trees/specializations depending on how you like to play or survive. At the end of each tree you will unlock a final perk or specializations, my favorite is the Tech Branch. "While you’ll still only be able to have one specialization skill active" you can use skills from other branches, just not the final one and yes you can unlock all the skills in the games and you can switch though your specialization skill.

This game is amazing I wish Avalanche Studios gave more money to Systemic Reaction for the game near the end. I wish/hope for Systemic Reaction to make a second game,
I will always come back to this game, it will remain one of or my favorite game ever. This game is unique and I will update this review if I have more to say later.
100/10
